title: The Killswitch Engage Quiz
subtitle: Three rounds. Twenty seconds a question. Fastest fingers win.
notes: Written by claude-sonnet-5 for "Killswitch Engage". NOT YET REVIEWED — read every question in the editor before the gig.

questions.prompt: Killswitch Engage formed in 1999 in which US state?
questions.answerNote: They formed in Westfield, Massachusetts.

questions.prompt: Which genre is Killswitch Engage most associated with pioneering?
questions.answerNote: They're considered pioneers of the melodic metalcore sound.

questions.prompt: Who is the current lead vocalist of Killswitch Engage (as of their recent albums)?
questions.answerNote: Jesse Leach returned to the band in 2012 and remains lead singer.

questions.prompt: Which guitarist of Killswitch Engage also produces the band's albums?
questions.answerNote: Adam Dutkiewicz has produced most of the band's records himself.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Killswitch Engage's bassist and founding member?
questions.answerNote: Mike D'Antonio co-founded the band and previously played in Overcast.

questions.prompt: Which singer fronted Killswitch Engage between Jesse Leach's two stints?
questions.answerNote: Howard Jones sang from 2002-2012, and Phil Labonte briefly filled in in 2012.

questions.prompt: Which Killswitch Engage album features the song 'My Curse'?
questions.answerNote: 'My Curse' appears on 2006's As Daylight Dies.

questions.prompt: What is the title of Killswitch Engage's 2009 self-titled album, their second one?
questions.answerNote: They self-titled two albums, the second one released in 2009.

questions.prompt: What was the name of Jesse Leach's other metalcore band before rejoining Killswitch Engage?
questions.answerNote: Jesse Leach formed Times of Grace with Adam Dutkiewicz.

questions.prompt: Killswitch Engage's drummer Justin Foley joined the band in which decade?
questions.answerNote: Justin Foley joined the band in 2002.

questions.prompt: Which record label released Killswitch Engage's debut album 'Killswitch Engage' (2000)?
questions.answerNote: Their self-titled 2000 debut came out on Ferret Music.

questions.prompt: Which band did Mike D'Antonio play in before co-founding Killswitch Engage?
questions.answerNote: D'Antonio and Dutkiewicz both came from the band Overcast.

questions.prompt: What is the title of Killswitch Engage's 2016 studio album?
questions.answerNote: Incarnate was released in March 2016.

questions.prompt: What is the title of Killswitch Engage's 2019 studio album?
questions.answerNote: Atonement was released in August 2019, featuring a duet with Howard Jones.

questions.prompt: Which Massachusetts city is most closely associated with Killswitch Engage's formation?
questions.answerNote: Westfield, Massachusetts is where the band formed.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Killswitch Engage's second guitarist alongside Adam Dutkiewicz?
questions.answerNote: Joel Stroetzel has been the band's lead guitarist since their debut album.

questions.prompt: Which of these is NOT a Killswitch Engage studio album?
questions.answerNote: The Sickness is a Disturbed album, not Killswitch Engage.

questions.prompt: Which song is the title track of Killswitch Engage's 2006 album?
questions.answerNote: 'As Daylight Dies' is the title track of the 2006 album.

questions.prompt: Which member of Killswitch Engage also plays in the band Times of Grace?
questions.answerNote: Adam Dutkiewicz co-founded Times of Grace with Jesse Leach.

questions.prompt: What year did Howard Jones officially depart Killswitch Engage?
questions.answerNote: Howard Jones left the band in 2012 due to health issues.
